usage.finalMessage:
I added the `quote <customer> <amount>` command, listed it in `help` right after `invoice`, and committed it with the report; `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes all 7 tests. Quotes use the 21-day terms of DEC-B12, the decision now in force, which matches the requirement's 2026-03-23 example.
One thing needs a decision: invoices are still due after 30 days under the replaced DEC-B01, and an existing test locks that in, so a quote and an invoice issued the same day show different due dates. I left invoices unchanged and recorded this as an open question in `.work/report.json`.

OUTCOME: completed
